body: Arts and Culture Commission - Special Meeting
agenda_text:
AGENDA
  GLENDALE ARTS AND CULTURE COMMISSION - SPECIAL MEETING
  GLENDALE CENTRAL LIBRARY
  Administrative Conference Room
  222 E. Harvard St. (2nd Floor)
  Glendale, CA 91205

Special Meetings of the Arts and Culture Commission are held at Glendale Central Library. For
public comments and questions during the meeting, call (818) 548-2030. Public comments on a
specific agenda item will be taken when that agenda item is discussed. If you have any question
about matters on the agenda, or requests for assistance, please contact the Library, Arts & Culture
Administrative Office at (818) 548-2030 during regular business hours.
  PLEASE TURN OFF CELLULAR PHONES WHILE INSIDE THE MEETING LOCATION

  SEPTEMBER 13, 2023 AT 9:00 AM

  1. SPECIAL BUSINESS AGENDA – 9:00 AM
  Roll Call
  a. Report of Recorder, re: Posting of Agenda. The Agenda for the September 13, 2023
  Special Meeting of the Glendale Arts and Culture Commission was Posted on
  September 11, 2023 at Glendale Central Library.

 2.  DISCUSSION ITEMS
  a. Beyond the Box – Call for Artists Applications

 3.  ADJOURNMENT
  The next Regular Meeting of the Glendale Arts and Culture Commission is Thursday,
  September 21, 2023, at 10:00 AM at City Council Chambers (2nd Floor) – 613 E. Broadway
  Glendale, CA 91206.
